name: list_skills
description: Browse installed skill names and descriptions without activating anything. Use proactively when the user asks about available skills, or after identifying a concrete, genuinely specialized need for domain context, an established workflow, bundled resources, or dedicated tools. Do not browse merely because a task contains technical keywords or involves a routine source-code, repository, file, or terminal investigation.

query.description: Optional concise keyword or phrase to filter skill names and descriptions. Omit to browse the installed catalog.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching skills to return (default 50, maximum 100).
